hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == */service/base/*Base.java ]] && [[ "$file" == */modules/* ]]; then echo "BLOCK: $file is a generated Service Builder base class — edit the *Impl instead, or run buildService to regenerate."; exit 2; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -f "$file" ] && grep -q '@generated' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCK: $file contains @generated — edit the *Impl or *ResourceImpl instead, then rebuild."; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run `graphify query \"<question>\"` before grepping raw files. Only grep after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run graphify before reading source files. Use: `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph), `graphify explain \"<concept>\"`, or `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"`. Only read raw files after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines. This rule applies to subagents too — include it in every subagent prompt involving code exploration."}}'; fi || true

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.java ]] && [[ "$file" != */modules/* ]]; then cd /opt/projects/liferay/portal/arena-7.4.3.129-ga129/portal && ant compile 2>&1 | grep -E '(error:|BUILD FAILED|BUILD SUCCEEDED|\[javac\])' | tail -20; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.java ]] && [[ "$file" == */modules/* ]]; then module=$(echo "$file" | grep -oP '.+/modules/[^/]+/[^/]+/[^/]+' | head -1); if [ -d "$module" ]; then cd "$module" && ../../../../gradlew compileJava 2>&1 | grep -E '(error:|BUILD FAILED|BUILD SUCCEEDED)' | tail -10; fi; fi
